surface: The treegrid rows of the NestedRows plugin: a collapse and an expand from the row header, and the level a cell announces.

steps.note: Enter on a parent's row header collapses it: the polite announcement names the row the way the plugin phrases it ("row 1"; a reader that names the row by its cell text says "root a"), and aria-expanded flips on the focused header.

aria-level, aria-posinset and aria-setsize sit on the row, so the level or the set position is required beside the cell's place. Finding: NVDA announces neither for a cell on both browsers (the committed goldens).
The parent's first child, one level down. Finding: NVDA announces no level or set position for a cell on both browsers (the committed goldens).
